meta.name: In Pursuit of Silence
meta.description: In the race towards modernity, amongst the buzz and jitter of technological innovation and the rapid growth of cities, silence is now quickly passing into legend. Beginning with an ode to John Cage’s seminal silent composition 4′ 33″, the sights and sounds of this film delicately interweave with silence to create a contemplative experience that works its way through frantic minds and into the quiet spaces of hearts. As much a work of devotion as it is documentary,In Pursuit of Silenceis a meditative exploration of our relationship with silence, sound, and the impact of noise on our lives.
